key_insight: Deployment-specific simulated control evaluations predicted safeguard effectiveness more accurately than evaluations executed in a separate control environment.
engineering_relevance: Language-model simulation of tool responses could make deployment-specific safeguard testing more sample-efficient while helping engineers improve monitors.
method: Replace environment execution with language-model-simulated tool responses.
Validate simulated control evaluations against executed outcomes in LinuxArena.
Compare prediction accuracy and attack characteristics with BashArena evaluations.
evidence_signal: Across five monitors at a 5% audit budget, simulated evaluations predicted safety with 3.6 percentage-point RMSE versus 10.1 for BashArena, and explained 78–85% of between-environment variance in attack success, monitor scores, and safety.
watch_item: Validation is centered on LinuxArena; simulation fidelity should be checked against execution before relying on results in other deployment environments.
